mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling real consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising policy rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions and higher consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening household demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising real consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a mixed labor market with weak aggregate demand but firm hiring, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment and rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based demand expansion, which boosts corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising real consumption and rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).
